notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where only the first giant star was showing up per level

Thanks for your patience while we figured this one out! ❤️

notes.title: New skaters, OST, Photo Contest, and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530185/256b83327f7fb9c9a2f8d1b28f42e7b16f3e65f7.png[/img]

It's been a little over a week since release and we're super excited to see everyone skating and shredding through the world of Stardust Valley. Thank you so much for all your support! ✨

We're excited to bring up a small update today that includes:
[list]
[*] FOUR NEW PLAYABLE MASCOT SKATERS! 🐶🐰🐱🐭
[*] Original Soundtrack release!
[*] Leaderboard fixes (for those who were having issues connecting and submitting their scores)
[*] General Bug and Spelling fixes
[/list]

Keep your eyes peeled for future updates! We have a few things cooking to make your skating runs more radical.

[h1]Original Soundtrack - OUT NOW![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621160/Stardust_Skate_Soundtrack/

[h1]Photo Contest![/h1]
[h3]Just a reminder that there are a few days left in our crashout photo contest!
Submit yours on social media using #VchiBan to enter![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530185/6c9454561efffa2edba90b974df79af7c6f12bc1.png[/img]


[b]More updates coming soon...[/b]
